extraction_issues.impact: Activity rows visible in PDF/XML are retained; missing MOESM source data prevents complete source-data-level audit.

extraction_scope: Worker-2/6 bounded re-review preserved locally obtainable PDF/XML activity, toxicity, resistance, and in vivo efficacy rows. Declared supplementary/source-data files remain absent locally.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Visible PDF/XML figure and prose values are preserved, but the local packet cannot support a source-data-level audit of all figure heatmap values, supplementary sequences, or replicate-level data.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The XML declares MOESM PDF/XLSX supplementary/source-data files, but the local supplementary assets are publisher HTML landing captures and the paper-local source/supplementary directory has no declared files.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: The source-visible activity rows can be retained, but APD6/DBAASP peptide identity rows that depend on sequence snapshots or missing supplementary sequence/source data cannot be promoted to source_verified.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The packet contains zero linked sequence-record rows. Main PDF/XML sources support only visible rumicidin and analog evidence, not a complete APD6/DBAASP identity snapshot for every linked database row.
